objects.description: During [HomeLand Justice](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0038), threat actors renamed [ROADSWEEP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1150) to GoXML.exe and [ZeroCleare](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1151) to cl.exe.(Citation: CISA Iran Albanian Attacks September 2022)(Citation: Mandiant ROADSWEEP August 2022)
